title: Fell asleep with the TV on
blurb: 40 minutes without movement at 01:30, TV still playing. The scene decider weighs turning it off. At-risk: measured 12B confidence was 39%.

steps.text: 01:30. Alex fell asleep on the couch with a movie still playing.
lying on the couch, eyes closed
40 minutes without movement. Perception reports 'idle' and the scene decider weighs turning the TV off.
Measured on 2026-10-20 the 12B picked 'turn off TV' at only 39%, below the ask band. This scenario tracks the question tuning and fails until the wording improves.
